post_title: What will Dabom's November 27, 2026 consumer price for a 30-egg pack of special-grade (특란) eggs in South Korea be?

question.title: What will Dabom's November 27, 2026 consumer price for a 30-egg pack of special-grade (특란) eggs in South Korea be?
question.description:
The Korea Institute for Animal Products Quality Evaluation (축산물품질평가원, KAPE) publishes daily farm-gate, wholesale and consumer prices for eggs on its Dabom (축산유통정보) portal, posting each daily figure in the early afternoon (around 13:00-13:15 KST). Its consumer-price series for special-grade (특란/XL) 30-egg packs is the standard reference Korean media use for "the price of a carton of eggs," and it is quoted in news reports almost weekly.

Recent path of that daily consumer price: 6,659 won on Oct 19, 2026; 6,875 won on Oct 31; then a jump of 479 won (+7.0%) to 7,354 won on Nov 5, which held through Nov 8. It has since eased: the latest value as of Nov 13, 2026 is 7,243 won, on the same day the farm-gate price was 4,975 won and the wholesale (sorted/packed) price 5,614 won per 30 eggs. The October 2026 monthly average consumer price was 6,868 won (-2.4% y/y); the November 2025 average was 6,499 won and the full-2025 average about 6,790 won. Daily values in this series move in steps of roughly 50-500 won, so a value two weeks ahead is genuinely uncertain.

The near-term driver is highly pathogenic avian influenza (AI). The first poultry case of this winter was confirmed on Nov 3, 2026 — earlier than last season — and by Nov 13 at least four cases had been confirmed, including layer farms in Yeoncheon (~91,000 birds, Nov 3), Yeoju (~260,000 birds, Nov 6; about 254,000 culled) and Ganghwa (~48,000 birds, H5N9 confirmed Nov 12), plus H5 detections at a Jincheon breeder-duck farm and a large Paju quail farm. Gyeonggi Province alone reports roughly 410,000 birds culled, and 24-hour movement standstills have been imposed on poultry facilities and vehicles in Seoul, Incheon and Gyeonggi.

Countervailing fundamentals are bearish for prices: the November 2026 layer flock is about 84.01 million birds, an all-time high, and October daily egg production averaged about 51.63 million eggs (+3.3% y/y). The Korea Rural Economic Institute's November 2026 livestock outlook forecast November egg production up 2.3% y/y with falling farm-gate prices. Last winter showed the same pattern: despite the first layer-farm AI case in mid-November 2025, the average consumer price fell 7.7% from 7,039 won in October 2025 to 6,499 won in November 2025, before rebounding to about 6,880 won in December 2025 and 7,080 won in January 2026.

There is also a live distribution-margin dispute: on Nov 9, 2026 the Korea Layer Association publicised farm-gate trades of about 4,800-5,000 won per 30 eggs against a KAPE consumer price of 7,354 won (a gap of roughly 53%) and asked the Fair Trade Commission to investigate, arguing retail prices rise even as farm-gate prices fall. Major hypermarkets have previously capped or discounted special-grade cartons, which can damp the pass-through of farm-gate moves into the surveyed retail price.

question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves based on the daily consumer price (소비자가격) for special-grade eggs (특란, shown as the "XL" grade) in KRW per 30 eggs (원/30개) published on the Korea Institute for Animal Products Quality Evaluation's Dabom (축산유통정보) egg distribution-price page: https://www.ekapepia.com/v3/price/livestock/egg/distrPrice.do. The resolved value is the consumer-price figure in the page's daily table row dated 2026-11-27 (date label as displayed), reported in won as displayed — e.g. a displayed price of 7,354 resolves as 7,354. If no row dated 2026-11-27 is published in that table, the figure in the latest row dated before November 27, 2026 governs. If the Dabom page cannot be accessed, the consumer price for the November 26, 2026 trading day as reported by [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions) will be used; if no value can be established, the question is annulled.
question.fine_print: The page reports prices in both 원/30개 (per 30 eggs) and 원/10개 (per 10 eggs); only the per-30-egg consumer price is used. Farm-gate (산지가격) and wholesale (도매가격) figures are not used. Row date labels are used exactly as displayed on the page; the underlying trading date (거래일자) of the November 27, 2026 row is irrelevant.
